about: Chloral hydrate liquid 5 mL (500 mg) at night is supplied every month for eight months. The supplies appear by the Australian brand name alone.
Chloral hydrate liquid 2.5 mL (250 mg) at night is supplied four times from January 2026 to April 2026, in the middle of a 15-month history.
Mirtazapine Sandoz (mirtazapine, a sleep aid that is not on the list) is supplied every month. No chloral hydrate is supplied.
